Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Time of day: midday — bright even light; a bright square of sunlight from the window on the floor.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.

COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with both hands she holds a small square golden mosaic tile set in a brick-red frame, one turquoise tessera at its centre in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — darmstadtium: a heavy synthetic metal below platinum, first made in 1994 by striking lead with nickel ions fired down a long straight accelerator in a research city that found six new elements, and named for that city, where an art-nouveau artists' colony was built on a hill in 1899 around a tall brick tower crowned with five rounded fingers and walls of golden mosaic, and where electrical engineering was first taught as a university subject — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: pear-shaped and curvaceous — slimmer shoulders over a narrow waist, full rounded hips and thick thighs, a full bust — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
